worldcombat.skill.inferno.summary: Plants a fire seal on the ground at the target point: a ring of scorched heat rumbles and heats up, then flame erupts from the earth and curls into a column that engulfs everything inside, burning whatever it wraps. The long fuse and narrow radius are a dodge window - step out of the seal and you escape.
worldcombat.skill.inferno.use.0: Trade a long fuse for one guaranteed-burn heavy blow
worldcombat.skill.inferno.use.1: Plant a fire seal where the foe is about to stand
worldcombat.skill.inferno.use.2: Wrap and burn a slow, heavy target whole
worldcombat.skill.inferno.use.3: Chase a target with follow-up columns in pin mode
worldcombat.skill.inferno.description.0: The column deals %1$s special damage to each body inside, about x1.22 in harsh sunlight and x0.82 in rain; their special defence, type matchup and criticals are settled on impact.
worldcombat.skill.inferno.description.1: Range %1$s blocks with a %2$s block column; the seal heats up for %3$s s first, and anyone stepping out of that window is not burned.
worldcombat.skill.inferno.rule.guarantee: A body wrapped by the column is always burned (type and ability immunities to burn still apply): while burning it deals half physical damage and loses about 6.25%% of its maximum health every 5 seconds (at least 1 point), lasting about 40 seconds or until cured.
worldcombat.skill.inferno.pin.on: Pin: the first column lands at the seal, then the columns chase the nearest foe near the seal for %1$s s, one every %2$s s, each follow-up at %3$s of the first; with no foe near the seal the later columns stay at the landing point.
worldcombat.skill.inferno.pin.off: Nova: a single column at the landing point; a target that walks away escapes.
worldcombat.skill.inferno.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s, costing %4$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.inferno.growth.0: From level %1$s the column rises to %2$s power and the fuse to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.inferno.growth.1: From level %1$s the column rises to %2$s power and its radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.inferno.preference.pin: On: the column chases the target for several beats (each at x pinEcho), with a bigger radius and far better odds, but x0.82 power per column, +4 fuse and +12 cooldown. Off (nova): x1.06 power, -2 fuse and -4 cooldown, but a target that walks away escapes.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: a target that is nearly still ranks first because it cannot leave the fuse window, making the blow reliable; off: order by ordinary ranged attack only.
